name: Sheraton Johor Bahru
short_description: Sheraton's first Johor Bahru hotel, a 345-room city property in Bukit Senyum minutes from the CIQ causeway, connected to SKS City Mall and built around a family-focused pool complex.
ai_summary: Opened in October 2025, the Sheraton Johor Bahru is the brand's debut in the city and sits atop Menara SKS in Bukit Senyum, directly connected to SKS City Mall and only a short Grab ride from the CIQ causeway to Singapore. Independent reviewers consistently praise the 345 spacious, Scandinavian-inspired rooms and suites, the generous buffet breakfast at Daily Social, and a well-equipped gym paired with a lap pool, cabanas and one of JB's largest kids' pools. Family Suites with bunk-bed kids' rooms and water-slide access make it a strong family pick, while Bonvoy elites report solid upgrades (several to Executive Suites) and a comfortable Sheraton Club lounge with an outdoor terrace. Service earns warm reviews for friendliness and thoughtful touches such as birthday decorations. Watch-outs reflect its newness: the earliest post-opening review flagged unpolished service, minor room defects and a thin lounge spread, and the pool is repeatedly described as smaller than expected for a five-star property. The Club lounge can also fill quickly on busy weekends. As a brand-new opening the property is still finding its rhythm, but the overall trajectory from later 2025 into 2026 is positive.

faqs.question: How far is Sheraton Johor Bahru from the Singapore causeway (CIQ)?
faqs.answer: The hotel sits in Bukit Senyum, roughly two kilometres from the CIQ complex and Causeway to Singapore. Reviewers report reaching CIQ in about a five-minute Grab ride costing only a few ringgit, making it convenient for cross-border travellers heading to or from Woodlands checkpoint.

faqs.question: Is Sheraton Johor Bahru good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes. It offers two-bedroom Family Suites with a king master bedroom and a kids' room with bunk beds, plus one of Johor Bahru's largest kids' pools with water slides. Direct access to SKS City Mall and spacious rooms make it a practical choice for families.

faqs.question: Do Marriott Bonvoy elites get lounge access and upgrades?
faqs.answer: Yes. Platinum Elite members and above receive Sheraton Club lounge access, and reviewers report generous upgrades, several to Executive Suites. The lounge offers breakfast, evening canapes and cocktails plus an outdoor terrace, though it can fill up on busy weekend evenings.

reviews.title: [Hotel Review] Sheraton Johor Bahru
reviews.author: Satu Kosong
reviews.summary: A family stay two weeks after opening: spacious Premier Club rooms and a big breakfast spread, but jammed plumbing, unpolished service and a thin evening lounge left the reviewer feeling it was overpriced until it matures.

reviews.title: Sheraton Johor Bahru: Luxury 5-Star Hotel with Family Suites Near CIQ
reviews.summary: A design-focused look at the new hotel: Scandinavian-inspired rooms, ocean-themed two-bedroom Family Suites with bunk beds and water slides, plus dining at Daily Social, Soo Noodles (open to 1am) and cabana-lined pool.

reviews.title: Review: Sheraton Johor Bahru
reviews.author: The Quiet Vacationer
reviews.summary: Praises spacious modern rooms, a standout Daily Social breakfast, a proper lap pool with cabanas and separate kids' pool, plus fast Platinum check-in; notes the compact Club lounge fills up on busy weekends.

reviews.title: Hotel Review: Sheraton Johor Bahru Hotel
reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.summary: A Bonvoy Platinum guest upgraded to an Executive Suite highlights spacious quiet rooms, a large Club lounge with outdoor terrace, excellent breakfast and friendly service; the main letdown was a small swimming pool.
